- [at-0001] Round money only with round_money: Always round monetary results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

candidate.title: Normalize money inputs with round_money before storing
candidate.content: Always pass monetary values through `round_money` from `ledgerly.money` before storing them on models or comparing them; never store raw floats or unrounded Decimals. Compare against `ZERO` from `ledgerly.money` rather than literal 0.

item.title: Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes
item.content: Reject invalid input by raising `BillingError(code, detail)` from `ledgerly.errors` with a stable snake_case code such as `invalid_state`, `invalid_quantity` or `negative_amount`, and put the offending value in the detail string.

item.title: Exclude bool when validating integer arguments
item.content: When validating an integer parameter, check `isinstance(x, bool)` first because `bool` is a subclass of `int`; reject bools along with non-ints and out-of-range values.
